title: In the Rust workspace at the workspace root (aura-harness), run the channel tests for the aura-app crate and report the…
summary: All 30 channel tests in `aura-app` passed when I ran `cargo test -p aura-app channels`: none failed and none were ignored. The command exited 0 and took about 1m 04s, almost all of it compiling. I didn't write or change any files.
